scope: Gaussian-ansatz TMD distribution and fragmentation functions at leading order without evolution: SIDIS F_UU,T(x, z, P_hT) with <P_T^2> = <p_perp^2> + z^2 <k_perp^2> in the conventions of Anselmino et al. and of Bacchetta et al. (z^2-normalized D_1), its collinear integral, the Cahn cos(phi_h) term at O(k/Q), the Sivers asymmetry A_UT^sin(phi_h - phi_S) in the Gaussian Sivers model (Anselmino et al. Eqs. 64-67, re-derived in SymPy and checked against Bacchetta et al. Eq. 4.11 with the Trento relation), the Drell-Yan q_T shape with <q_T^2> = <k1^2> + <k2^2>, and the SIDIS -> Drell-Yan Sivers sign change (Trento Eq. 14, cited). Physics status heuristic-argument: the Gaussian ansatz with constant widths is a model.
exclusions: TMD evolution, the soft factor, b-space formalisms and matching to collinear factorization at large P_hT
Fits of widths or Sivers parameters; the paper's fitted values are used only as illustrative settings
A Drell-Yan Sivers asymmetry formula (only the sign of the Sivers function is propagated)
Collins, Boer-Mulders and other azimuthal modulations; flavour- or x-dependent widths
Any experiment, detector, data or blinding field; no comparison with measurements

capabilities.name: sidis-unpolarized-and-cahn
capabilities.scope: SymPy: Gaussian convolution gives F_UU,T with <P_T^2> = <p_perp^2> + z^2 <k_perp^2> in both conventions (Bacchetta z^2-normalized D_1 with <p_perp^2> = z^2 <k_T^2>), its d^2P_hT integral is x sum e^2 f D, and Eq. 32-33 reproduce the Cahn term of Eq. 38 (also from Bacchetta Eq. 4.20 with Eqs. 2.9, 2.11). Published closed form Eqs. 38-39 against 2D quadrature of the profile's transcription of the same integrands at 4 points (relative tolerance 1e-7; same route as the paper, checks algebra and transcription, not physics); consistency check against skills/hep-theory/scripts/tmd_gaussian.py sidis (same author). Within the Gaussian model (heuristic-argument)

capabilities.name: sivers-asymmetry
capabilities.scope: SymPy: Eq. 58 with Eqs. 63 and 68 reproduces Eqs. 64-67, and Bacchetta Eq. 4.11 with Trento Eq. 4 gives the same asymmetry; published closed form Eqs. 64-67 against 2D quadrature of the profile's transcription at 4 points (relative tolerance 1e-7; same route, checks algebra and transcription, not physics). Within the Gaussian Sivers model (heuristic-argument)
